model_solution: 1. المقياس: \( r = \sqrt{(2\sqrt{3})^2 + (-2)^2} = \sqrt{12+4} = 4 \). 2. السعة (الربع الرابع): \( \cos\theta = \frac{2\sqrt{3}}{4} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \) و \( \sin\theta = \frac{-2}{4} = -\frac{1}{2} \)، إذن \( \theta = 2\pi - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{11\pi}{6} \). 3. ديموافر للأس \( -2 \): \( (2\sqrt{3}-2i)^{-2} = 4^{-2}\left(\cos\left(-\frac{11\pi}{3}\right) + i\sin\left(-\frac{11\pi}{3}\right)\right) \). 4. \( 4^{-2} = \frac{1}{16} \). 5. تبسيط الزاوية: \( -\frac{11\pi}{3} + 4\pi = \frac{\pi}{3} \). 6. \( \cos\frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{1}{2} \) و \( \sin\frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \). 7. الناتج: \( \frac{1}{16}\left(\frac{1}{2} + i\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = \frac{1}{32} + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{32}i \).
